target: close selected wide and hyperedge APMA interactions without enumerating the Boolean boundary cube
pipeline: compile universal width<=3 APMA typed mosaic
define boundary variables as variables present in more than one module
project each module exactly onto its boundary
recognize and solve only if joined boundary CNF is renamable Horn
lift boundary witness through every module projection and verify original CNF

projection_languages.2CNF: exact width-preserving Davis-Putnam elimination; polynomial unique-clause universe
projection_languages.HORN3: C039.1-style exact single-head Horn projection only
projection_languages.DUAL_HORN3: literal-complement to single-head Horn, exact projection, complement back

recognizer: polynomial 2-SAT system over variable polarity flips; no q-Horn DFS
frozen_controls: WIDE_RENAMABLE_SAT family through boundary width >=16 must close without boundary enumeration
WIDE_RENAMABLE_UNSAT with individually satisfiable native carriers must certify UNSAT
HYPEREDGE_RENAMABLE case may close without pairwise-interface restriction
random small admitted cases exact brute replay
next_if_pass: expand symbolic shared-boundary carrier beyond renamable Horn, preferably audited q-Horn or richer proof-carrying relation
next_if_fail: preserve falsifier and localize projection, recognition, or witness-lift mismatch
